variants.text: Older male with a round face, receding hairline, thin arched eyebrows, and dark-rimmed rectangular eyeglasses, wearing a striped dark shirt.
Older male with a round face, receding hairline, thin arched eyebrows, a wide nose with a bulbous tip, and thin upper lips. He is wearing dark-rimmed rectangular eyeglasses and a striped dark shirt.

Older male, round face, high rounded forehead, convex profile, receding hairline with hair at temples and back. Thin sparse arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes partially obscured by dark-rimmed rectangular eyeglasses. Straight nose with wide bridge and bulbous tip. Wide mouth, thin upper lip, fuller lower lip, upturned corners, visible upper teeth, medium philtrum. Permanent horizontal forehead creases, prominent nasolabial folds, wearing a striped dark shirt.

This is an older man with a round face, a receding hairline, and thinning eyebrows. He has a distinctive nose with a bulbous tip and wears dark rectangular glasses. He is smiling and wearing a dark striped shirt.
